native.english: Can you see me? Here I am! Hello, hello!

rows.text: ママがお風呂に入ってくるね

web.english: Bath time is here! Is the water warm? Splash, splash!

native.english: Bath time is here! Is the water warm? Splash, splash!

rows.text: おもちゃで遊んだらお水を飲もうね

web.english: Look at you! What a sweet face. I'm glad you're here!

native.english: Look at you! What a sweet face. I'm glad you're here!

rows.text: 眠くないけど少し横になろうか

web.english: Are you sleepy? Let's get cozy. Night-night!

native.english: Are you sleepy? Let's get cozy. Night-night!

rows.text: 泣きそうだけどまだ泣いてないね

web.english: I hear you crying. I'm right here. You're not alone.

native.english: I hear you crying. I'm right here. You're not alone.

rows.text: お外は雨だからおうちで遊ぼうね

web.english: Rain is falling! Can you hear it? Pitter-patter!

native.english: Rain is falling! Can you hear it? Pitter-patter!

rows.text: 笑わなくても大丈夫だよ

web.english: Hi, little one! Peekaboo! Hello again!

native.english: Hi, little one! Peekaboo! Hello again!

rows.text: おむつを替えなくてもまだ大丈夫だよ

web.english: It's diaper time. I'll be gentle. I'm here with you.

native.english: It's diaper time. I'll be gentle. I'm here with you.

rows.text: お着替えしたと思ったけどまだだったね

web.english: Let's put clothes on. One arm first. Other arm next!

native.english: Let's put clothes on. One arm first. Other arm next!

rows.text: ミルクを飲み終わるまでは待とうね

web.english: Let's pause feeding. We can wait now. I'll stay with you.

native.english: Let's pause feeding. We can wait now. I'll stay with you.

rows.text: 今日はお散歩には行かないよ

web.english: Let's go outside! Look at the sky. What do you see?

native.english: Let's go outside! Look at the sky. What do you see?

rows.text: お歌はもう終わったけど絵本はこれからだよ

web.english: Our book is finished! That's the last page. Well done, sweetheart.

native.english: Let's read a book! Look at the pictures. What's that?

rows.text: ねんねから起きてごはんを食べようね

web.english: Time for a bite! Here's your spoon. Open wide!

native.english: Time for a bite! Here's your spoon. Open wide!

rows.text: まだできあがっていないね

web.english: Hello, sweet baby! You're so loved. I'm right here.

native.english: Hello, sweet baby! You're so loved. I'm right here.

rows.text: おしまいかどうか分からないね

web.english: You're my little sunshine. I love you. Big hugs!

native.english: You're my little sunshine. I love you. Big hugs!

rows.text: もう一回はやらなくていいよ

web.english: One more time? Let's try again. Ready to go?

native.english: One more time? Let's try again. Ready to go?

rows.text: 大丈夫じゃないみたいだね

web.english: Hello, little one! Can you hear me? Hi there!

native.english: Hello, little one! Can you hear me? Hi there!

rows.text: かわいいけど眠ってはいないね

web.english: My sweet baby! Big, big hugs! Hello, sweetheart!

native.english: My sweet baby! Big, big hugs! Hello, sweetheart!

rows.text: まだ始めてないんだよ

web.english: Let's say good morning! Hello, sweet baby. Hi there!

native.english: Let's say good morning! Hello, sweet baby. Hi there!
